title: Iranian nuclear civil-defence video reported
description: Media reporting describes an Iranian civil-defence video providing shelter and decontamination guidance. The existence of public guidance does not establish an imminent nuclear strike; the original broadcast remains to be checked.
whyItMatters: Civil preparedness messaging is observable separately from speculation about nuclear use.
nextWatchpoints: Retrieve and authenticate the original broadcast and publication date.

title: Reports of US strikes on Qeshm Island
description: Reuters reported strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island citing other reporting and officials. This node records the dated report, not independently established operational details or a nuclear escalation.
whyItMatters: Separates reports of conventional military activity from hypothetical nuclear use.
nextWatchpoints: Confirm date, targets and damage using independent and official sources.
